reply_text:
Found one merge-blocking issue in `receipt-lines` against `main`:

*P1 — Printed amounts are 100× too large* — `receipt/render.py:2`
`format_money()` formats cents directly as dollars without dividing by 100. For example:
• `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00`, not `$12.99`.
• Two coffees at 450 cents each render as `Coffee               $900.00`, not `$9.00`.

Convert cents to dollars before formatting. Add literal expected-value assertions: the current rendering test compares the output against the same faulty `format_money(900)`, so it passes despite the incorrect amount.

All 3 existing tests pass. Reviewed through commit `a6c40d4`; no files changed.
